name: isEncryptionKeyManaged
definition: every active project or workspace on the AI platform encrypts its data with a customer-managed key held in the customer's own KMS, not only vendor-managed encryption.
population: the active (not archived) projects or workspaces in one organization on the AI platform, read in full
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the organization's active projects or workspaces (every page) in which each one names a customer-managed key; a null or empty key id makes the answer false, and a missing key field is not measured.

changeLog.change: Registered so the OpenAI transform can emit it; the Anthropic transform already emitted it unregistered.

notes: OpenAI reports the key as external_key_id on each project (Enterprise Key Management). The check reads that a key is named, not that the KMS grant is healthy. Whether the Anthropic implementation measures the same thing was not reviewed.
